title: Dimensional Containment and Information-Flow Integrity
abstraction_boundary: Higher-dimensional geometry is used strictly as a formal model for codimension and projection leakage in software systems. Phrases such as 2D binary substrate are conceptual labels only.

Dimensional Containment and Information-Flow Integrity (v1.1.0-rc1 historical artifact)
Orthogonal Isolation
formal_condition: P:X->Y, F:X->O, F = F_tilde o P on fibers of P; P(x1)=P(x2) => d_O(F_t(x1), F_t(x2)) <= eps. eps=0 for discrete observables; eps>0 only for declared numeric observables with a 001C amplification bound. Runtime: F_tilde receives only typed serialized y=P(x) and cannot read raw x.

title: Robust Barrier Enforcement
formal_condition: Closed-form robust CBF-QP on a disturbance ball for the control-affine model; discrete-time compiler steps use h(x_{k+1})-h(x_k) >= -a h(x_k) for all d_k in D, 0<a<=1. h(x)<0 on entry => FAIL_CLOSED OUTSIDE_SAFE_SET, no control applied. Non-finite or ill-formed input => NUMERICAL_TOLERANCE_FAILURE. Apply filtered u when feasible. Proven infeasibility, solver timeout, and numerical tolerance failure => FAIL_CLOSED at runtime. Offline tests assert the specific mode.

title: Influence and Causal Containment
formal_condition: d_Y(y_auth(u1), y_auth(u2)) <= gamma * d_X(u1, u2) on I_auth with declared metric, normalization, domain, and horizon; strict noninterference on x_priv; E_unauth=0 across F_n o ... o F_1; sink registry plus whitelisted system-generated writes; side-effect-free replay. Numeric eps>0 observables, if any, must declare a 001C amplification bound.
enforcement_scope: Authorized interfaces, privileged state, downstream sinks, and durable state

title: Resource-Bounded Enforcement
formal_condition: R_execution + R_enforcement + R_reserve < R_budget (STRICT, PROVISIONAL_DEFAULT, pending_deliberation: true); a debit that would land exactly on the reserve is refused with PREEMPTIVE_FAIL_CLOSED, is not billed, and emits needs_review / BOUNDARY_EDGE_PENDING_DELIBERATION. Execution, enforcement, and reserve are separate counters. If R_free ever reaches R_reserve, the independent emergency supervisor fires immediately. Supervisor stops admissions, terminates, isolates, keeps bounded audit evidence, quarantines; no automatic resumption.
enforcement_scope: Kernel scheduler, resource accounting, and emergency supervisor
